title: Thought catcher
desc: Asks now and then if there's anything worth noting down

variables.name: asked_window
variables.desc: the shallow window last asked on (app and title)

variables.name: stretch_asked
variables.desc: whether this distraction stretch was asked on

signals.name: staying
signals.expr: delay(app_name, 0.25) == app_name and delay(app_title, 0.25) == app_title and ts_count(app_name, 0.25) == 0 and ts_count(app_title, 0.25) == 0
signals.desc: on the same window for 15 seconds

signals.name: distracted
signals.desc: in distractions for 5 minutes, a minute's break at most

signals.name: near_distraction
signals.desc: a distraction in the last minute

idle.desc: waiting for shallow work or a distraction

next.desc: on a shallow window, not asked on yet
a distraction stretch, not asked on yet

stretch_over.desc: the next stretch may be asked on

context.format: Anything worth noting from {app}? Write it down, and get back to what matters.
